criteria.reason: 7/20: conclusions.json connects Eli project interest, the corrected service-door image, the matching credential event and the lab presence/absence bounds; this provides a plausible lead and some useful corroboration. It invents corroborating person/object footage in V10 (a static clock notice), asserts a service-corridor journey and 18:14?18:18 removal despite possession at 18:14, treats coat/badge attribution as certain and clears all other staff from isolated appearances. Those false supports and insufficient identity/authorization/route alternatives materially weaken the 0.85 responsibility conclusion.
